value: 35 Swedish health care students (medical, nursing, dentistry)
17 traveled to Central Africa; 18 to Indian peninsula
Fecal specimens collected median 4 days before departure and 22 days after return
Two-thirds participated in hospital-based patient work
None took antibiotics within 6 months prior to or during travel
178 different resistance gene types detected across specimens
Shotgun metagenomic sequencing using Illumina HiSeq 2000
ESBL screening using chromogenic culture media and genome sequencing
No significant differences in resistance gene abundances between two destinations
